handover_chars.description: The longest handover block, in characters, without its one-line head. What does not fit is cut by rank: pins and open commitments first, then the topic, then the latest turns, the summary last. The leaf of a new session carries the note and the topic; a renewed live session's block carries all of them.

renew_rounds.description: How many of the newest rounds (one session and turn each) a renewed live session is told as text, beside the summary, the pins and the topic.

description.purpose: What one session leaves for the next, and what a renewed live session of the same call needs to carry on (GH #896). When a session closes, `./summarizer` writes a handover note off the hot path, kept as a block of kind `summary` with a `marks` row `handover` (state `prepared`). On the first call of a NEW session `./policy` hands the call here once: the system leaf `history.handover` is set -- the note of the session served last and the topic still open, put together without a model -- and the call goes back to `./policy`, which reads its window itself. When a duplex session of a running call was renewed, the running conversation is put together without a model and leaves as a `sidecar` section `context` that carries `renewal_n` and `call_id`.
description.not_in_scope: No wall writes and no window: `./intake` writes the wall and `./policy` builds the window. No model of its own: the note goes through `./summarizer`, the one model door of the hive. The pack family `handover` belongs to the identity pusher and is never touched here; this cell's leaf is `history.handover`.
description.emits_meaning: lstore: ledger reads and writes; once per new session the last bundle answers to `./policy` (phase `handover-done`, reason `handover`) with this cell's writes only. summarize: the handover note request for `./summarizer`. sidecar: the block for a renewed live session, section `context`, its words under `payload`.
description.consumes_meaning: in_close (a closed session), handover (from `./policy`: the first call of a session it did not serve last), in_renewed (a renewed duplex session: `call_id`, `renewal_n`), in_summary (the note), and the ledger's answers to its own steps.
